pages.title: hyponatremia — page 2
pages.status: 3 rows flagged — all 3 measured and all 3 confirmed. First of the described-only pages to be measured.
pages.lead: The work order gave no coordinate for any row on this page; every endpoint below was found by reading the artwork at 3-5x and confirmed by sampling the tissue under it with the leader's own ink excluded.

findings.label: Hypothalamus (osmoreceptors)
findings.now_desc: frontal-lobe cortical gyri, sampled (193,136,120). The leader is in TWO faint segments (ink peaks at x 105 and x 140) and both die in cortex
findings.target_desc: the gold hypothalamic nucleus at the top of the pituitary stalk, sampled (238,168,47) - unmistakable against anything around it

findings.label: Posterior Pituitary (stores & releases ADH)  [CHECK]
findings.now_desc: sampled (118,60,32), dark suprasellar tissue 12 px ABOVE the gland - the order is right that it stops short
findings.target_desc: the pinkish-brown pituitary teardrop at the foot of the stalk, sampled (166,91,77)

findings.label: Glomerulus
findings.now_desc: sampled (150,68,58) - the red arteriole entering from the left, OUTSIDE Bowman’s capsule
findings.target_desc: the bright red capillary tuft inside the capsule, sampled (184,85,68). Both arterioles are separately labelled on this panel, so the tuft is the only thing left unnamed

pages.note: Bowman’s Capsule on the same panel is CORRECT - its leader ends at (456,447) on the gold capsule ring, sampled (108,71,32). That matters for the fix: the Glomerulus leader has to reach past the capsule ring to the tuft inside it, so the two cannot simply be swapped end for end. ONE CORRECTION TO THE ORDER: it says the hypothalamic target is '~250px to the right'. Measured, it is 57 px (dx 53, dy 21). The direction and the target are right; the distance is not.

pages.title: bipolar — page 2
pages.status: 4 rows flagged — all 4 measured and all 4 confirmed, each endpoint carrying 37-56 px of leader ink.
pages.lead: A circuit diagram drawn over a midsagittal brain: coloured nodes joined by coloured pathway arcs, with white leaders running in from the numbered labels. Three of the four flagged leaders stop on a PATHWAY ARC rather than on the NODE the label names - the arcs are the conspicuous thing at that point on the page, and the leaders stop at the first one they meet.

findings.label: ⑤ HYPOTHALAMUS
findings.now_desc: sampled (123,99,127) - the purple GABA pathway arc, high and posterior in parietal white matter
findings.target_desc: the gold circuit node at the base of the diencephalon below the thalamus, sampled (172,135,39)

findings.label: ② ANTERIOR CINGULATE CORTEX
findings.now_desc: sampled (144,138,147) - the blue-tinted prefrontal band, well anterior to the cingulate
findings.target_desc: the cingulate gyrus immediately above the genu of the corpus callosum, sampled (204,167,149), where the orange arc runs

findings.label: ③ AMYGDALA  [CHECK]
findings.now_desc: sampled (107,176,148) - the GREEN PATHWAY ARC, not the node
findings.target_desc: the green amygdala sphere itself, sampled (118,186,112), 63 px to the right

findings.label: ④ BASAL GANGLIA  [CHECK]
findings.now_desc: sampled (96,77,77) - the pale corpus callosum at the upper margin of the deep-grey mass
findings.target_desc: inside the purple basal ganglia / thalamic mass, sampled (109,73,88)

pages.note: All four are short moves - 36 to 176 px - and none needs re-routing, because each label already approaches from the correct side. Row 3 is the cheapest and the clearest: 63 px along the leader's own axis, from the green arc onto the green sphere, both sampled and both unambiguous. ⑥ HIPPOCAMPUS and ⑦ BRAINSTEM were checked too and are not flagged here: ⑦ ends at (520,542) on the teal brainstem node, correct. ⑥'s leader ends at (617,523) on the CEREBELLUM, which is not the hippocampus - that row is NOT in the work order and needs the physician's read before we call it.

pages.title: b12-anemia — page 2
pages.panel: Labeled anatomy: vitamin B12 & folate absorption
pages.status: 4 rows flagged — all 4 endpoints measured; 3 targets measured, 1 needs placing from source.
pages.lead: No coordinate was given for any row on this page; every endpoint below was read off the artwork and confirmed by sampling the tissue under it. Three of the four faults are the same shape: a badge or leader stops on the DUODENAL/BOWEL tube it happens to overlie rather than on the organ its legend names.

findings.label: ③ marker — legend "Parietal Cells"
findings.now_desc: the badge sits on the pink DUODENAL C-LOOP at the pylorus, sampled (225,132,117) just under it
findings.target_desc: the gastric body/fundus where parietal cells actually sit, sampled (215,97,89)

findings.label: Pancreas  [CHECK]
findings.now_desc: the leader stops at the badge ③ ring on the pink duodenal wall - the orange pancreas does not begin until x≈455, so it is ~24 px short

findings.label: ⑥ marker — legend "Transport" (B12 enters portal blood)  [CHECK]
findings.now_desc: sampled (112,52,48) - the pink BOWEL WALL. The leader runs left from the badge, curves up and dies on the gut
findings.target_desc: the blue portal vein drawn immediately to its left, sampled (22,69,119) - unmistakable against the bowel

findings.label: ⑤ Terminal ileum  [CHECK]
findings.now_desc: the badge sits on the bowel loop descending on the patient’s LEFT (the aorta/IVC pair run at x 430-467, so midline is ~455 and this loop is left of it)
findings.target_desc: the right lower quadrant, where the terminal ileum and cecum belong. PLACE FROM SOURCE - sampling the viewer-left lower quadrant returns background ((0,9,17) at (380,830)), so we could not find a distinctly drawn cecum to put a pixel on

pages.note: Row 1 has a second half the order flags and we confirm by absence: there is NO ④ marker anywhere on the figure, although the legend lists ④ Duodenum. So either the ③ badge is really the missing ④ sitting in the right place with the wrong number, or ④ was dropped. THAT CHANGES THE FIX - if it is a numbering error, renumber the badge rather than moving it, because it is already on the duodenum. Worth one look at the source file before anything is dragged. Rows 1, 2 and 4 are otherwise short, unambiguous moves.
